      Creates a measurement-backed builder without accepting a separately invented channel tag.
      Parameters:
      source - actual configured measurement
      unit - held-sample engineering unit
      setpoint - trip setpoint

      Returns:

    • manualTripFromPushButton

      public static SafetyFunctionChannel.Builder manualTripFromPushButton(PushButton source)
      Starts a discrete manual-trip channel from an actual local push button.

      This reads the button's binary latch, not a pressure held sample. Linked automatic actions are prohibited so the safety function, rather than a hidden button side effect, owns final-element actuation.

      Parameters:
      source - local native push button in the configured process
      Returns:
      binary high-trip builder with a one-half threshold
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the button is absent, subclassed or owns linked automatic actions
